# Vaccine schedule

## Hepatitis B Vaccine

* At birth if infant's birth weight ≥ 2,000g  
* At 30 days of life if infant's birth weight < 2,000g  
*Give at 30 days of life even if the infant has not reached 2 kg.*

<br><br>{{< pagebreak >}}

## 2-month vaccine

* Pediarix (dTaP, HepB, Polio)
* PCV
* HiB

<br><br>{{< pagebreak >}}
